activity_summary: After the Shrew, which you did not play, the tiring-house door shut. You gave them Kettleby word for word. John said twice that if you are sent for you go, and that a company which asks the Queen for money down is not sent for twice. The cost is the boat, the lodging, and the boys' meat for five days, out of a stock that holds six pound. Kemp stopped on being first, and told the grocer to be first. George will stand with John. You were second on the Queen's paper once. Tom said you were paid before Easter. No sum was written.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the call word for word, refused a second place on the paper, and kept the column empty.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Said the matter twice, named the six pound and the shoes, and shut the book on the question.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Began to claim the first place, stopped, and gave it to the grocer.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked for the sending-for in plain words, and told him to keep the column empty.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Stood with Heminges and refused to spend the six pound in talk.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked to hear the sentence twice, and remembered being paid before Easter.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Asked after the king, and kept the boys' five days inside the six pound.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: If we're sent for, we go.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Let the grocer be first. He likes a passage to wait in.

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
quotes.text: And you were paid before Easter. Ah, the old days.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will write that it is expected.
